office_name: Department of Planning & Development Review, Bureau of Permits and Inspections
work_requiring_permit: Building permit for new construction, additions, alterations, repairs, removal, demolition (VRC 108.1); decks require permit. Exceptions per code incl. ordinary repairs, replacement windows/doors, cabinetry. MEP and gas work each need a separate trade permit (no plans needed for trade permits). VA USBC 108.2 exemptions commonly cited: ordinary repairs; replacing windows/doors in existing openings of same size (1-2 family/townhouse); replacing plumbing fixtures without altering supply/drain/vent; replacing cabinets, trim, floor finishes, paint; re-roofing/siding on 1-2 family; detached 1-story sheds <=256 sq ft; fences/privacy walls <6 ft (not pool barriers); low-voltage (<50V) wiring. Exempt work must still meet code.
required_documents: Online application via Online Permit Portal (OPP); construction documents for building permits; trade permits applied separately.

fee_notes: Permits Fee Schedule PDF (Aug 2024).
notes: Email PDRPermitsAndInspections@rva.gov. Homeowner guide goal: initial review within 10 business days; P&I page warns some types may take 2-3 weeks. Building inspections must be requested before midnight the day before. Portal help: CSSHelp@rva.gov.
